These small public fixtures contain regression facts, without game binaries,
decryption code, native memory or pointer traces, account data, or UI captures.

- `native-codes.json` contains 130 community-published build-code strings and
  their source URL/date. It preserves independent codec roundtrip coverage.
- `official-numeric-candidates.json` contains five dated published automatic
  weapon profiles, numeric damage/range/RPM facts, primary source URLs, and short
  evidence phrases. These are dated theoretical-DPS inputs, with no claim that
  they cover current hotfixes, every hit region, attachments, recoil, or sway.
- `name-regressions.json` preserves eight exact item names, raw spelling, native
  positions, localization hashes, registered source IDs, and diagnostic codes.
  It verifies the packaged name and identity contracts; original native recovery
  evidence is retained privately and is not required or executed by this suite.

The reviewed description policies and compact name inventory are public project
metadata under `metadata/`. Runtime tests verify that technical descriptions stay
separate from real names and never become search aliases or named build cards.
